notes.title: STAX is 25% off in honour of new title Minoes
notes.content: In honour of the release of Moda Code Games' next title; Minoes, STAX is 25% off until the 18th of May. Minoes is also has 25% off this week as an opening launch discount. If you're a fan of matching puzzle games, stack-em-ups or unique new indie games, you should check out Minoes here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1271760/Minoes/

notes.title: STAX out now on Mac!
notes.content: STAX is out today on Macs everywhere! Get it through Steam, where it is also available on PC. Now we can push forward towards further upgrades and improvements on the road to version 2.0. Stay tuned!

notes.title: MAC version delay
notes.content: The PC edition will go ahead on Monday 1st Feb, but the Mac edition will unfortunately be delayed by up to two weeks. This is to ensure that the experiences between all platforms will be exactly the same and avoid any bugs that could arise before sufficient testing. Apologies for the delay but rest assured it will be worth the wait!
